patterns.note: Content is primarily presented in a single central column on light backgrounds, with some sections utilizing a multi-column grid for related items like researcher profiles or research topics.
A strong typographic hierarchy is established by pairing large, elegant serif display fonts for main section titles with clean, readable sans-serif fonts for body text and subheadings.
A sophisticated palette of dark grays, light grays, and white dominates for backgrounds and text, accented by a deep crimson for institutional branding elements.
The main navigation bar remains fixed at the top of the viewport upon scrolling.
Content sections are revealed with a subtle fade-in and slight upward slide as they enter the viewport during scrolling.
The hero section features a background image that scrolls at a slower rate than the foreground text content, creating a parallax effect.
Horizontal thin lines are consistently used as subtle visual dividers to separate content blocks or list items within sections, reinforcing structure.

technique_notes: The main navigation bar is implemented as a sticky header, maintaining its position at the top of the screen as the user scrolls down the page.
Sections are revealed using scroll-triggered animations, where elements fade in and translate slightly upwards as they become visible in the viewport.
The hero section employs a parallax scrolling effect, where the background image moves at a slower speed than the foreground text, creating a sense of depth.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, elegant serif headings (approx. 3-4x body text) are used for major section titles, while body text and subheadings use a clear, readable sans-serif.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle. Images and cards have very slightly rounded corners, almost sharp.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced. Sections have generous vertical padding, while content within sections (like the grid of researchers or research topics) is more tightly packed but still breathable.

standout: The site effectively blends the gravitas of an academic institution with a modern, clean design. The use of elegant serif typography for major headings against a backdrop of professional photography and clear sans-serif body text creates a sophisticated and authoritative feel without being overly formal or dense. The subtle scroll-triggered reveals enhance engagement without distracting from the serious content.
